description: Serves a Flashtimer workspace's countdown timer images and click links from a subdomain of the customer's domain (for example timers.example.com). The CNAME on the host sends its traffic to Flashtimer, the _acme-challenge CNAME delegates certificate validation (ACME DNS-01) for that host to Cloudflare, which issues and renews its TLS certificate, and the _flashtimer TXT record proves which Flashtimer workspace the domain owner connected.
variableDescription: %verification%: the Flashtimer workspace's ownership token for this host, 22-64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-].
